senses.gloss:
आध्मा €1 P.
—1 To inflate, puff up, swell.
—2 To blow or fill with wind, sound (as a conch &c.). ━pass. To
 be elated or inflated, be filled; तव भुजबलदर्पाध्मायमानस्य वामः
 शिरसि चरण एष न्यस्यते वारयैनम् Ve. 3. 40; Mv. 5. 2.

आध्मानम् [आ-ध्मा-ल्युट्]
—1 Blowing inflation; (fig.) growth, increase; अयं विन्ध्यो येनाहृतविहृतिराध्मानमजहात् Mv. 7. 14.
—2 Boasting, vaunting.
—3 A bellows.
—4 Intumescence, swelling of the belly, body &c., dropsy.
आध्मापनम् A means of inflating or causing a sound.
